title: Sum of Digits
description: Given a non-negative integer n, return the sum of its digits.
hints: n % 10 gives the last digit.
n // 10 removes the last digit.

title: Is Prime
description: Given an integer n, return True if it is a prime number, otherwise False. Numbers below 2 are not prime.
hints: Handle n < 2 first.
You only need to test divisors up to the square root of n.

title: Palindrome Number
description: Given an integer n, return True if it reads the same forwards and backwards. Negative numbers are never palindromes.
hints: Rule out negatives first.
Converting to a string makes reversing easy.

title: Reverse Words
description: Given a string s, return a string with the words in reverse order, separated by a single space. Ignore extra spaces at the start, end, or between words.
hints: str.split() with no argument ignores extra spaces.
A list can be reversed, then joined with ' '.

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: Given two lists a and b, each sorted in ascending order, return one sorted list containing all elements of both.

examples.explanation: Elements are interleaved in sorted order.

hints: Keep one index into each list.
Repeatedly take the smaller front element, then append whatever is left.

title: Most Frequent Element
description: Given a non-empty list of integers, return the value that appears most often. If several values tie, return the smallest of them.
hints: Count each value in a dictionary.
For ties, compare by count first, then by smaller value.

title: Move Zeroes
description: Given a list of integers, return a new list with all zeros moved to the end while keeping the order of the non-zero elements.

examples.explanation: Non-zero values keep their relative order.

hints: Collect the non-zero values first.
Then pad with as many zeros as were removed.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a list of integers sorted in ascending order and a target value, return the index of the target, or -1 if it is not present.
hints: Keep a low and a high index.
Look at the middle element and discard half of the range each step.

title: Common Elements
description: Given two lists of integers, return a sorted list of the distinct values that appear in both lists.
hints: Sets support intersection with &.
Sort the result before returning it.
reference_solution:
def solve(a, b):
    return sorted(set(a) & set(b))

title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Given a list of strings, return the longest prefix shared by all of them. If there is none, return an empty string.
hints: Start by assuming the first word is the prefix.
Shorten the prefix until every other word starts with it.
